title: Macropad, module on top: MX keys and a 2.0 in display
note: The front-mount macropad built: twelve MX switches soldered to the board (no plate) with DSA keycaps, a DO-35 diode in the gap beside each, the thin module soldered flat on its castellated pads above the keys, and a 2.0 in ST7789 display on a standard socket at the module's right end, lying flat over the module and the board above it, clear of the keys. The board's underside is z = 0, and a USB-C cable plugged into the module through the board's slot.

fits.note: The display lies clear over the module (its parts reach about 1 mm above its board)
fits.label: Display over the module
